reviews.title: Great for disk hard drives
reviews.comment: nifty little hard drives work like a charm. I haven't seen a 2.5 inch platter drive - they are neat. BUT little shipping SNAFU mainly caused by Amazon itself. Customer Service was really quick to blame the store. there’s no fault there. I actually wound up calling them on the telephone and talking to then. Turns out I’m not the first to have this issue. Amazon transposed shipping information with another order - one $400, the other $20.
reviews.author: David B. Bartolini

reviews.title: Actual product is not green but still a good hdd
reviews.comment: Drive was new and delivered quickly. I did not receive what the image on the Amazon page showed, it is instead a relatively bare HDD. To be clear, I am referring to the product being different in appearance and not the packaging. I am building a pc as a gift, and the theme is neon green. The hdd bay on the pc case basically displays the hdd, which lead me to buy this green one. It is not green, it is chrome and blue which is disappointing.
reviews.author: Nicholas N.

reviews.title: Great product and support.
reviews.comment: Packaging was amazing. It didn't come with the screws, but after contacting the seller they shipped them immediately.
